question:

Answer in seconds (rounded to 1 decimal place)
model_output:
To determine how many seconds the ball traveled after hitting an object, we analyze the sequence of frames and identify when the ball first hits a wall (a gray vertical line) and then calculate the time it travels before the next hit.

---

### **Step 1: Identify the First Hit**

- At **1.6 seconds**, the blue dot (ball) is shown **next to a gray vertical line** on the right side of the screen. This indicates that the ball has **hit the right wall**.
  
This is the **first time the ball hits an object**.

---

### **Step 2: Determine When the Ball Next Hits a Wall**

After hitting the right wall at **1.6 seconds**, the ball bounces back to the left. The next time the ball is shown **next to a gray vertical line** (i.e., another wall) is at **4.3 seconds**.

At this point, the ball is **next to two gray lines on the left**, indicating it has **hit the left wall**.

---

### **Step 3: Calculate the Time Traveled After the First Hit**

The time between the first hit (1.6 seconds) and the next hit (4.3 seconds) is:

$$
4.3 - 1.6 = 2.7 \text{ seconds}
$$

This is the **time the ball traveled after hitting the object** (the right wall).

---

### **Conclusion**

The ball traveled for **2.7 seconds** after hitting the right wall at 1.6 seconds before it hit the left wall at 4.3 seconds.

$$
\boxed{2.7}
$$
